protocol.ordinaryCode: Arbitrary2..10characters, upper/lower/digits and separators at arbitrary positions; perfont24independent samples plus12casepairs (48rows). No room prefix/leading letter/two-digit school grammar or lookup repair.
protocol.hardPairUnits: PerJPfont8Il1 triple units +12O0 pair units =48rows. All variants share exact font/render condition and full context. Every member is a new registered target with no prior literal/image/tensor overlap.
protocol.equivalenceAudit: TRAIN ONLY: all single-position Il1/O0 counterfactuals rendered in same condition; any normalizedinput alias rejects entire atomic unit before admission. Global PNG/input/CNN-feature contradiction audit excludes entire conflicting train units before updates. DEV/FRESH: ordinary generation keeps all admitted atomic members, including identical input/differentlabel; no oracle alias filter, all rows are main evaluation denominator. Alias diagnostic only after model scoring/selection; never used in rank.

sourceRendering.sharedGeometry: common baseline/relative glyphheight/font advance/kerning/internal gaps, all source ink preserved; no perglyph scaling or position reset
sourceRendering.trackingRule: Global typesetting tracking, same in all variants; preserve each font glyphadvance/kerning contrast, do not normalize internal gap by target.
sourceRendering.strokeExpansionOriginalPixels: 0 or1 only at density>=2;0 at density1. Physical rendered targetweight augmentation; not arbitrary erosion/cutout labelled intact.
sourceRendering.preprocess: Exact unchanged bbox+2/native BGR48 FP32/originalpixel center bilinear and uint8round/normalizedzero padding, W320..960/validWidth/CTC source intervals; no new frame or output repair
sourceRendering.shaping: PIL RAQM with ligatures disabled, pair kerning/font advances retained; globally uniform tracking. Same seed/size/density/tracking/stroke/color in each atomic unit. Renderseed and exact sourcegeometry stored.

protocol.postSelection: Selectedhash then fixedfresh once; retain every regression, no fresh reselect/retrain. Only promising artifact standardONNX full438/dictionary/geometryCTC/license; actual C# routes and every document/page remain root criteria.
protocol.exclusion: Exact target literal/NFKC+strip/fulltarget UTF8SHA exclusion from all prior manifests/cache/public synthetic research/root oracles; root room/code ASCII suffix/numeric/CJK components included, legacy21201hashes included. No casefold or arbitrary substring/character prohibition. Root reserved3fonts never loaded/rendered/evaluated; old user PDFs/derivatives never reacquired.

training.frozen: All official CNN parameters/BNstats byte unchanged from v1; all BN runningstats fixed in evalmode throughout. Japanese primary untouched.
training.trainable: Official encoder/full438classifier and independent reject head only, original architecture/config/normeps unchanged
training.cache: Lossless FP32 CNN/teacherfeatures/full438probabilities. Train input tensor regenerated only for pixel evaluations from hashed PNG; dev/fresh keep FP32input too. All tensor hashes recorded, no FP16. Original full model vs cachedCNN bytes/decoder/reject equality on everynewdev before optimizer.
training.loss: Standard full438CTC for intact positives/empty blanks, no guessedCTC on other controls; full teacherKL/featureMSE +BCE. No new contrast loss or arbitrary output boost.

protocol.selection: Baseline fallback. Eligible only if codeCER and wholeCER strictly improve, every JPdevfont codeedits do not increase, naturalCER <=baseline+.002, raw highCTC wrong<=baseline+1, wrongAccepted<=baseline+1, negativeAccepted<=baseline+1, unsupportedpadding alwaysrefused. Rank codeCER/wholeCER/-exact/earliestepoch. This relative gate does not require zero errors; parent product qualification remains separate. Fixed before model execution.
